description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_Encoder class, which provides static methods for UTF-8 string cleaning, encoding conversions, and character handling, specifically for encoding, decoding, and sanitizing UTF-8 strings within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Encoder
classes.description: A static class providing UTF-8 string cleaning and encoding conversion methods.

methods.name: cleanUTF8
methods.description: Cleans a UTF-8 string for well-formedness and SGML validity, removing control characters and invalid sequences.

methods.name: unichr
methods.description: Converts a Unicode codepoint into its UTF-8 character representation.

methods.name: convertToUTF8
methods.description: Converts a string from a specified encoding to UTF-8 based on configuration.

methods.name: convertFromUTF8
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to another encoding based on configuration, with optional ASCII character escaping.

methods.name: convertToASCIIDumbLossless
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 string to ASCII with non-ASCII characters encoded as numeric entities.

methods.name: testEncodingSupportsASCII
methods.description: Tests whether a given encoding supports ASCII characters, returning a mapping of UTF-8 characters to ASCII.
